extension.description: On-demand Videos and TV Shows from novasports.gr
Βίντεο on demand και εκπομπές από το novasports.gr
extension.disclaimer: This addon offers content available in Greece and is not published nor endorsed by novasports.gr
Το πρόσθετο αυτό προσφέρει περιεχόμενο διαθέσιμο στην Ελλάδα και δεν έχει δημοσιευθεί ούτε εγκριθεί από το novasports.gr
extension.news:
[B]3.0.0[/B] - Complete rework for the new WordPress based novasports.gr - All four video providers are resolved (Kwik, Glomex, Connatix/FirstView, YouTube) - External subtitles for Kwik, Glomex and Connatix clips - Browse by sport, competition, team and show - Matchcenter with date navigation, jumping to the competition's videos - Search, paginated listings and per page setting - Modernized stack: tulip 4.x, urldispatcher, netclient, unicache - Live section rebuilt on the NovaSports YouTube channel (scrapetube), since the site no longer offers live streams - Scheduled broadcasts notify when they start instead of failing to play
[B]2.2.0[/B] - Change cache method - Tweak label indexes
